# SuperCLI

> A community CLI directory with search, purpose and vendor filters, official tool links, installation commands and transparent GitHub repository star rankings.

## Website
- [Explore CLI tools](https://supercli.site/): directory, filters and ranking methodology.
- [Catalog data](https://github.com/webkubor/supercli/blob/main/data/catalog.json): canonical list of tools and official sources.
- [Metrics snapshot](https://github.com/webkubor/supercli/blob/main/data/metrics.json): snapshot timestamp and repository-bound GitHub statistics.
- [Contribution guide](https://github.com/webkubor/supercli/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): submit a pull request for local human review.
- [Icon sources](https://github.com/webkubor/supercli/blob/main/docs/ICONS.md): vendor and maintainer asset provenance.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/webkubor/supercli/blob/main/SECURITY.md): report vulnerabilities privately to the maintainer.

## Interpretation
Stars describe the linked repository, including its other packages when it is a monorepo. They are not CLI downloads, active users or a quality score. Tools without comparable GitHub data remain unranked. Source filters distinguish vendor-maintained CLIs from community projects; these labels are provenance, not quality ratings. No visitor machine inspection is performed.

No MCP server, user voting system or automatic PR approval is provided. Official third-party names and trademarks belong to their owners.

- [Public inclusion standards](https://supercli.site/standards): provenance labels, documented review scope and installation testing are separate. Historical items without a review record are marked as pending documentation, not passed or failed.
